description: Strip away assumptions to rebuild from fundamental truths - breakthrough technique for innovation and solving impossible problems
Use targeted questions to reveal hidden assumptions and guide discovery - excellent for teaching and self-discovery
Explicitly list every assumption underlying a plan - rate each by confidence and impact - then stress-test the weakest — prevents building on shaky foundations
Require at least three independent source types (quantitative - qualitative - expert) before accepting a claim — guards against single-source bias
output_pattern: claim → source A → source B → source C → confidence rating

description: Optimist researcher + skeptic researcher + synthesizer review sources - balanced assessment of evidence quality
Student defends hypothesis against committee with different concerns - stress-tests research methodology and conclusions
Force explicit intermediate reasoning steps before any conclusion — prevents intuitive leaps that skip flawed logic
Construct the strongest possible version of an opposing argument before responding — builds credibility and catches blind spots that strawmanning misses
output_pattern: opposing view → strongest form → honest rebuttal

description: Flip the problem by asking what would guarantee failure instead of how to succeed - reveals hidden obstacles and blind spots by approaching challenges from the opposite direction
output_pattern: goal → invert → failure paths → avoidance → solution

description: Imagine future failure then work backwards to prevent it - powerful technique for risk mitigation before major launches
Find the simplest sufficient explanation by eliminating unnecessary complexity - essential for debugging
Break a complex problem into independent sub-problems - solve each - then reassemble — essential when a task is too large or tangled to tackle whole
Move up ("why?") for strategic clarity or down ("how?") for tactical detail — ensures you're solving at the right altitude
Multiple analysts evaluate options against weighted criteria - structured decision-making with explicit scoring
Systematic review to identify strengths and weaknesses then improve - standard quality check for drafts
Walk through step-by-step thinking to show how conclusions were reached - crucial for transparency
Explain complex concepts simply as if teaching a child - the ultimate test of true understanding
Challenge whether the stated problem is the real problem — often the question itself is wrong and a better framing unlocks an easy answer
output_pattern: stated problem → reframe → true problem → solution

description: Explore multiple reasoning paths simultaneously then evaluate and select the best - perfect for complex problems with multiple valid approaches
Model reasoning as an interconnected network of ideas to reveal hidden relationships - ideal for systems thinking and discovering emergent patterns
Generate multiple independent approaches then compare for consistency - crucial for high-stakes decisions where verification matters
Think beyond immediate consequences to anticipate cascading effects and long-term implications - essential for strategic decisions where first-order solutions create hidden downstream problems
output_pattern: action → consequences → second-order effects → informed choice

description: Two personas argue opposing positions while a moderator scores points - great for exploring controversial decisions and finding middle ground
Rotate through six modes (facts - feelings - caution - optimism - creativity - process) to ensure a group covers every angle without crosstalk
output_pattern: white → red → black → yellow → green → blue

description: Adversarial attack-defend analysis to find vulnerabilities - critical for security testing and building robust solutions
Serially adopt each stakeholder's world-view to see the same situation differently — reveals whose needs are being overlooked
output_pattern: perspective A → B → C → gaps found

description: Treat any model or diagram as a lossy abstraction of reality - check where the representation diverges from the real system before trusting it
output_pattern: model → reality check → divergences found → corrected understanding

description: Explore alternative realities to understand possibilities and implications - valuable for contingency planning and exploration
Systematically explore how each component could fail - critical for reliability engineering and safety-critical systems
Play devil's advocate to stress-test ideas and find weaknesses - essential for overcoming groupthink
